svg.title: Historic-area CLIP: from a local street scene to a candidate map point
svg.desc: The local default or opt-in Google image is joined to latitude, longitude, heading. A street scene is compared with four prompts: historic, modern, mixed, open space. Relative similarities feed a weighted map point, not historical identity.
svg.text: Historic-area CLIP: from a local street scene to a candidate map point
Default: sampled local images and cached scores. Google Street View and fresh CLIP inference are explicit opt-ins.
Compare this scene with four texts
Weighted point on map → inspect the image and source
